metadata.summary: This letter reactivates Pennsylvania's approved Evergreen Disaster Relief State Plan Amendment to include the following flexibilities: waiving the collection of premiums for all CHIP beneficiaries through July 31, 2023. The state will resume the standard premium and cost sharing policies for individuals who have completed a full renewal in the last 12 months. The state will resume the collection of premiums on a rolling basis as renewals are conducted through the state’s COVID-19 PHE unwinding period, scheduled to end February 29, 2024.
